tube_straight.notes: 12-sided round, thick transparent shell; exact 2m cardinal or 2sqrt(2)m diagonal pitch. Rotate cardinal directions; diagonal end centers lie on cell corners and use diagonal neighbour spacing.

tube_straight_crossing.notes: 12-sided round, thick transparent shell; exact 2m cardinal or 2sqrt(2)m diagonal pitch. Source crossing is walkable density=FALSE with two ports, not a four-way routing junction. Collision handling must honour source passability.

tube_diagonal.notes: 12-sided round, thick transparent shell; exact 2m cardinal or 2sqrt(2)m diagonal pitch. Rotate cardinal directions; diagonal end centers lie on cell corners and use diagonal neighbour spacing.

tube_diagonal_crossing.notes: 12-sided round, thick transparent shell; exact 2m cardinal or 2sqrt(2)m diagonal pitch. Source crossing is walkable density=FALSE with two ports, not a four-way routing junction. Collision handling must honour source passability.

tube_curve_left.notes: 45-degree cardinal-to-diagonal transition reconstructed as a curved round shell. Mirrored curves have different connection handedness; each may be rotated. No stepped square pixel outline.

tube_curve_right.notes: 45-degree cardinal-to-diagonal transition reconstructed as a curved round shell. Mirrored curves have different connection handedness; each may be rotated. No stepped square pixel outline.

tube_junction.notes: True three-way connected hollow Y-shell with Boolean-united walls, no intersecting glass inside the fork. N/SW/SE ports. Source junction0/1 use the same geometry and opposite preferred exits, exposed as prefer_left/right state clips; gameplay selects exit direction.

tube_station.notes: Two separately animated boarding-side covers for normal/flipped placement. Original open/close duration .6 seconds; runtime selects boarding side and five-second departure cooldown. Through station, east/west ports. Round 12-sided bore; geometry floor origin and Pod_Dock at tube axis.

tube_station_dispenser.notes: Source dispenser stays open, spawns temporary pod on boarding and deletes arriving pod. Two boarding-side state choices, no invented closing cycle. Through station, east/west ports. Round 12-sided bore; geometry floor origin and Pod_Dock at tube axis.

tube_terminus.notes: Two separately animated boarding-side covers for normal/flipped placement. Original open/close duration .6 seconds; runtime selects boarding side and five-second departure cooldown. Single east port and physical end cap; reverse-launch terminus. Round 12-sided bore; geometry floor origin and Pod_Dock at tube axis.

tube_terminus_dispenser.notes: Source dispenser stays open, spawns temporary pod on boarding and deletes arriving pod. Two boarding-side state choices, no invented closing cycle. Single east port and physical end cap; reverse-launch terminus. Round 12-sided bore; geometry floor origin and Pod_Dock at tube axis.

transit_pod.notes: Round capsule fits tube bore; separate occupant socket and original empty/occupied indicator states. Move the root along the network at floor-origin height, orient +Y along travel. Reusable pod, deconstructed into the same unattached model; contents are runtime actors, not painted onto glass.

transit_pod_temporary.notes: Round capsule fits tube bore; separate occupant socket and original empty/occupied indicator states. Move the root along the network at floor-origin height, orient +Y along travel. Source temporary pod materializes at dispenser and is deleted on station arrival: materialized/dissolved visibility clips supplied.
